content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Spartanburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to ensure you meet education and experience thresholds before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all required contact hours—delivered synchronously by active certified practitioners—to satisfy PMI's formal education requirement and build the knowledge foundation for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application, documenting your project-management experience. Pay the associated exam fee to PMI. Granite PM Academy's team can guide you through the application process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center and sit for the computer-based assessment on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP remains active for three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or conference attendance to renew your credential. Plan your PDU strategy early to stay current and competitive in your local job market.
